name: google-maps-transit
description: Google Maps: directions between two places from suggestions, public transport, a departure time, then the first route's details.
goal: On Google Maps, get directions from "Eiffel Tower" to "Louvre Museum": open the directions, fill in both places choosing each from the suggestions, choose public transport, set the departure time to leave at "9:00 AM", and open the details of the first route.
